summary: A static, light (#fbfbfb) Synthesia pricing page at 1244x996; nothing moves across the 3s (the 0s vs 2.9s difference is 0.0% of the frame). Top bar: the blue rounded-rect 'synthesia' logo at left (x112,y22) and a globe icon plus 'Log in' at right (to x1132). A large centred dark navy heading 'Pricing that scales with your needs' (~40px, y80-122). Below it, at left, a pill segmented control with a dark navy active 'VIDEO & SESSIONS' and an inactive 'API'; at right, grey 'Save up to 3 months with yearly' and a pill radio group 'MONTHLY' (empty ring) / 'YEARLY' (filled dot). Four plan cards 234px wide with 28px gaps run from x112 to x1132, y234-502, about 12px radius: Basic and Starter are flat light grey; Pro is a vertical gradient from deep navy (#0c1030) at the top to periwinkle (#a0b0ef) at the bottom, with a translucent 'MOST POPULAR' pill; Enterprise is a vertical gradient from near-black plum (#141222) to warm gold (#c0a669). Each card has a title at y~266, a price line at y~388, a credits chip (y411, 30px) and a full-width button (y451, 31px): dark navy buttons on Basic, Starter and Enterprise, a white button on Pro. Under Starter and Pro sit light grey bordered 'CREDITS' panels (y517-723) with a blue coin icon, usage lines and a 'Roleplays / + Add learner seat' row. Below these are feature lists of thin line icons and dark labels, separated by hairline dividers, with faint vertical column rules between columns. All type is a geometric sans with dark navy (#060a20) text. The lists run off the bottom edge.

criteria.check: Nothing moves: the page at 0.5s and at 2.5s is identical, with no scroll, hover state or animation anywhere
Background is a flat off-white (~#fbfbfb), not pure white and not tinted
Logo sits top-left at about x112, y22, around 75px wide
Logo is a blue rounded-rectangle ring mark followed by a dark bold lowercase 'synthesia' wordmark
Top right reads 'Log in' in dark grey regular ~15px, with a thin grey globe icon to its left at about x1060
Heading reads exactly 'Pricing that scales with your needs'
Heading is horizontally centred on the page (centre x≈622), with its cap line at y≈84 and baseline at y≈118 (~40px type)
Heading is dark navy, medium weight with tight tracking, not bold-black and not grey
Segmented pill at x112-353, y166-200: the active segment 'VIDEO & SESSIONS' is a dark navy pill with white caps; 'API' is dark caps on the light track
At right, 'MONTHLY' has an empty ring radio and 'YEARLY' has a filled dark radio dot, inside a light pill outline ending at x1132
Grey small text left of the radios reads 'Save up to 3 months with yearly'
Four plan cards of equal width (~234px) in one row from x112 to x1132, top y234, bottom y502, with ~28px gaps
Cards have rounded corners of about 12px
Basic and Starter cards are flat light grey (~#f3f3f3), with no gradient
Pro card is a smooth vertical gradient from deep navy (~#0c1030) at the top to soft periwinkle (~#a0b0ef) at the bottom, with no banding and no hard stops
Enterprise card is a smooth vertical gradient from near-black plum (~#141222) at the top to warm gold (~#c0a669) at the bottom
Card titles read 'Basic', 'Starter', 'Pro', 'Enterprise' at ~22px medium, left-aligned 20px inside each card at y≈266; dark on Basic/Starter, white on Pro/Enterprise
A translucent navy pill reading 'MOST POPULAR' in white small caps sits right of 'Pro' at about x696-793, y256-278
Basic price reads '₹0 per month', with large '₹0' (~22px) and smaller 'per month'
Starter shows a struck-through grey '₹1,999' and 'Billed yearly.' above '₹1,499 per month'
Pro shows a struck '₹6,199 Billed yearly.' above white '₹4,649 per month'
Enterprise shows white 'Let's talk.' at ~22px on the price line (y≈388) instead of a price
Chips read '500 CREDITS / MONTH', '15,000 CREDITS / YEAR', '72,000 CREDITS / YEAR' (with a down chevron) and 'CUSTOM CREDIT VOLUMES'
Basic and Starter chips are white with a thin grey border; the Pro chip is filled pale lavender (~#ebeefb); the Enterprise chip is a translucent outline over the gold, with light text
Each card has a full-width button 194x31 at y451, inset 20px from the card sides
Basic, Starter and Enterprise buttons are dark navy (~#06091f) with white text; the Pro button is white with dark text
Button labels read 'Get started', 'Get started', 'Get started', 'Book demo'
Below the Starter and Pro cards (not Basic or Enterprise) sit light grey, thinly bordered rounded panels from y517 to y723
The CREDITS header has a small blue filled circle icon with a white mark, inside a white rounded square, then bold caps 'CREDITS' and a grey info circle
Starter panel lines read 'Video up to ~150 min', 'Dubbing up to 197 min', 'Surveys up to 42 responses', with the 'up to …' part darker/bolder than the label
Pro panel lines read 'Video up to ~720 min', 'Dubbing up to 947 min', 'Surveys up to 205 responses'
Each credits panel ends with 'Roleplays' and an outlined pill '+ Add learner seat' at y≈694
Basic list reads 'Free allowance' (bold, info icon), 'Share your content online via share link', 'Pre-built libraries, templates, roleplays, surveys', 'Videos carry a Synthesia watermark'
Starter list begins 'Everything in Basic +' (bold) then 'Download your content', 'Remove Synthesia logo', 'AI Video Assistant', 'Survey Analytics', '3 guests', '125+ Synthesia AI Avatars'
Pro list begins 'Everything in Starter +' then '5 Personal Avatars', 'Branded video pages', 'Interactive videos', '5 guests', '180+ Synthesia AI Avatars', 'Flexible plan tiers'

Enterprise list begins 'Everything in Pro +' directly under the card (y≈531) and includes 'Unlimited video minutes', '1-Click Translations into 140+ languages', 'SAML/SSO', 'Brand Kits', 'SCORM export', 'Dedicated CSM'
Enterprise list rows are spaced about 37px apart (Unlimited video minutes y≈568, 240+ stock AI Avatars y≈660, SAML/SSO y≈735) and the list runs off the bottom edge
Every feature row has a thin outline icon (~14px, 1.5px stroke) in dark grey to the left of its label, not filled glyphs
Feature rows are separated by hairline light grey horizontal dividers spanning the column text width
Faint vertical grey rules run between columns below the cards at about x360, x622 and x884, down to the bottom edge
Feature labels are dark navy ~13px regular on the off-white page; the first 'Everything in … +' row and 'Free allowance' are semibold
